eps.ov: Komari knows she’s a bottom-tier vampire and has questions that need answers. How did she become a Crimson Lord? Why does she have an army? And who is this maid in her room?
eps.oa: تعرف «كوماري» أنها مصاصة دماء في أدنى المراتب، ولديها أسئلة تحتاج إلى جواب. كيف صارت من الأسياد القرمزيين؟ ولماذا لها جيش؟ ومن هذه الخادمة في غرفتها؟

eps.ov: The life of an army commander is never dull, as questionable officers, an assassin, and even a duel can attest to.
eps.oa: حياة قائدة الجيش لا تعرف الملل، يشهد بذلك ضباط مريبون وقاتل مأجور، بل ومبارزة.

eps.t: The Darkness of the Shut-in Vampire Princess
eps.ov: Komari comes face to face with the one who bullied her three years ago.
eps.oa: تواجه «كوماري» وجهاً لوجه من كانت تتنمر عليها قبل ثلاث سنوات.

eps.t: The Mercy of the Lonely Crimson
eps.ov: Komari knows she’s weak, but she can’t abandon Vill. She will fight Millicent, even if her chances of winning are low.
eps.oa: تعرف «كوماري» أنها ضعيفة، لكنها لا تستطيع أن تتخلى عن «فيل». ستقاتل «ميليسنت» ولو كانت فرص فوزها ضئيلة.

eps.t: Sakuna Memoir and the Seven Crimson Lords
eps.ov: High-level officials are being murdered and Komari is tasked with hunting down the terrorist responsible alongside a Crimson Lord wanting revenge against her killer.
eps.oa: يُقتل كبار المسؤولين، وتُكلَّف «كوماري» بمطاردة الإرهابي المسؤول، ومعها إحدى الأسياد القرمزيين تريد الثأر من قاتلها.

eps.ov: Komari’s future hangs in the balance when another Crimson Lord calls for her impeachment.
The Crimson Lords hold a competition where the contestant with the lowest score must resign.
Sakuna shares a personal tragedy with Komari, but just as their bond deepens, another Crimson Lord makes his presence known.
Komari receives a tea party invitation from the Moonpeach Princess to ease tensions between their two countries, which convinces the Crimson Lord that it’s an obvious trap.
It’s not every day that one unintentionally starts a war, but that’s the situation Komari finds herself in. At least things can’t get any worse, right?
The fighting rages on and alliances are tested.
Nelia’s determination to stop Rainsworth grows stronger, but she cannot defeat him without Komari’s help.
